display.purpose: Primary section title within glass panels.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for pairing and connections.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ffffff; color: #1f2937; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s, border-color 0.25s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }

components.name: Glass Container
components.html:
Identity

Devices on the same network can pair directly.
components.css: .ds-card-glass { background: rgba(42, 42, 42, 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); } .ds-card-title { color: #e5e5e5; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-text { color: #a3a3a3; font-size: 14px; margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-input-text { background: #ffffff; color: #374151; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; outline: none; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: box-shadow 0.25s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-input-text:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); transform: scale(1.01); }

narrative.overview: Zendix utilizes a modern, dark 'liquid glass' visual philosophy designed to mimic the feeling of high-speed fluid connectivity. Interactive panels resemble translucent glass containers holding floating, animated fluid cores (QR codes, state pulses, and loading shimmers) that shift dynamically to represent direct WebRTC connection states.
keyCharacteristics: Refractive Depth through translucent panels with blur filters (backdrop-blur-2xl)
Dynamic Fluidity from low-intensity keyframe animations representing active peer-to-peer circuit
Tactile Feedback on hover/focus states to simulate physical elevation
Tighter Information Density designed strictly for speed and utility

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: The active Liquid Cyan accent must never exceed 10% of any screen's surface area.

rules.name: The No-Faded-Ink Rule
rules.body: Muted gray text on any dark background must maintain a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Tighter Ratio Rule
rules.body: Keep font steps between 1.125 and 1.2. Product interfaces require dense information hierarchy.

rules.name: The Glass Stack Rule
rules.body: Glass layers are layered sequentially. Dropdowns/modals sit on the absolute top with a dark backdrop-mask.

dos: Do use strict dark-mode-first styling to sustain a premium, technical aesthetic.
Do verify text contrast of ash-gray labels (#a3a3a3) against dark container surfaces.
Do implement fast transition timings of 150-250ms for hover, focus, and state switches.
Do include screen-reader-only text (sr-only) on non-prose buttons and indicators.
donts: Don't use colored side-stripe borders as accents on cards or notifications.
Don't use gradient text under any circumstances.
Don't animate img elements or their direct wrappers on hover.
Don't let text overflow grids or container cards.
